rss_feeds.name: Defense M&A Transactions

rss_feeds.name: Defense Tech Funding
rss_feeds.google_alert_query: ("defense tech" OR "dual-use" OR "defense startup") (raises OR raised OR secures OR backed OR funded) (million OR billion)

rss_feeds.name: Generalist Defense Investors
rss_feeds.google_alert_query: ("Founders Fund" OR "Thrive Capital" OR "General Catalyst" OR "8VC" OR "Sequoia Capital" OR "Lux Capital" OR "Coatue") (defense OR "national security" OR military OR aerospace OR "defense tech" OR autonomy OR hypersonic OR munitions) (raises OR raised OR funding OR Series OR led OR invests)
rss_feeds.notes: Added 2026-06-06 (gap-fill: generalist/crossover investors). Catches megafund-led defense rounds the boutique-VC feed misses. Verified 6/6 — sample hits: Lux $1.5B defense fund, Hadrian $260M led by Founders Fund, General Catalyst Indian defense round, 8VC Israeli defense. Named megafunds + defense context + deal verb. Uses existing scorer words (no vocab change needed). The named-firm list will need periodic refresh as the crossover roster shifts.

rss_feeds.name: Gov Strategic Capital
rss_feeds.google_alert_query: ("Office of Strategic Capital" OR STRATFI OR TACFI OR "Industrial Base Analysis and Sustainment" OR "Defense Industrial Base Fund") (loan OR investment OR award OR equity OR million OR billion OR funds OR financing)
rss_feeds.notes: Added 2026-06-06 (gap-fill: government strategic capital — leading indicator of industrial expansion). IMPORTANT: deliberately does NOT use 'Defense Production Act' or bare 'Title III' — tested 6/6 and those terms returned almost entirely Trump/coal/energy DPA noise. Anchored on defense-specific program names (OSC, STRATFI/TACFI) + capital verb. Verified clean: OSC $700M Vulcan loan, OSC/MP Materials critical-minerals loan, $20B loan-program budget request. Precise terms = very low noise.

rss_feeds.name: Defense Private Credit
rss_feeds.google_alert_query: ("venture debt" OR "private credit" OR "credit facility" OR "term loan" OR "debt financing") (defense OR aerospace OR "defense tech" OR military OR "national security")
rss_feeds.notes: Added 2026-06-06 (gap-fill: private credit / venture debt), STAGED OFF. Returns items (75 in 6/6 test) but NOT YET ENABLED because the keyword scorer lacks debt vocabulary ('venture debt','private credit','credit facility') — enabling without those scorer additions risks items getting auto-rejected at stage 1. ENABLE TOGETHER WITH the matching scorer phrase additions (use multi-word phrases, not bare 'credit'/'debt', to avoid loosening existing feeds). DISABLED AGAIN 2026-07-26: Google News RSS links (news.google.com/rss/articles/...) now return an 11-char JavaScript stub with no meta-refresh, so the scraper cannot reach the article — measured 0 of 74 scraped on the 7/26 verification run. Items still pass scoring + AI screening, costing tokens for zero triage output. The scorer vocabulary added alongside them is kept (it is independently correct). Re-enable only if sourced from direct publisher RSS instead of Google News.
